requirements: All prerequisite tasks are marked DONE in the selected execution path: WES-002, WES-003.
Owning repository has an active branch with contract/codegen artifacts synchronized to current baselines.

userStory.desire: As a Codegen Pipeline Architect, I want one-pass schema-to-IR/Rust/TS generation so output parity is guaranteed and maintenance overhead drops.

motivation.summary: One-pass codegen removes duplicate transformation paths and enforces cross-artifact parity.
supportsOrUnblocks: Directly unblocks ECO-003, ECO-004, and X-003.
Improves determinism by centralizing ordering and emission logic.

acceptanceCriteria: Single codegen profile emits IR, Rust, and TypeScript outputs in one deterministic pass.
One-pass workflow eliminates duplicate intermediate transforms between per-language generators.
Profile integrates with sync tooling expectations for downstream repos.

assertions: One-pass generation test verifies all expected artifact sets are produced atomically.
Cross-artifact parity test verifies op ids/schema hashes align across IR/Rust/TS outputs.
Performance baseline test verifies one-pass generation outperforms or matches prior multi-pass flow.
goldenPath: Run one-pass profile on canonical schema and consume emitted IR/Rust/TS artifacts directly.
Trigger downstream build in sample app to verify generated artifacts are integration-ready.
edgeCases: Partial generation failure cleans up incomplete output sets.
Feature-flagged schema sections include/exclude deterministically across all artifact targets.
fuzzScale: Generate large schema graphs through one-pass profile and verify bounded memory and stable timing.
failureCases: Failure in any emitter stage aborts full profile with stage-specific diagnostics.
Mismatch in cross-artifact schema hash fails generation and blocks publish.

inScope: Code, tests, and docs directly required to complete WES-004: One-pass app codegen profile (schema -> ir/rust/ts).
Boundary contracts and adapters touched by this task within project ownership.
Task-level observability needed to debug deterministic behavior and integration outcomes.
outOfScope: Unrelated feature work outside dependency chain impact.
Broad redesigns not required to satisfy acceptance criteria for this task.
Cross-repo migration work not explicitly referenced by this task dependencies.

definitionOfDone: All acceptance criteria are satisfied with linked test evidence.
